model: Schneider Electric APC Symmetra PX 250/500 kW UPS via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: Schneider Electric APC Symmetra PX 250 kW and 500 kW UPS systems on Modbus, read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the APC Symmetra PX 250/500 kW: 621 objects (241 AI, 380 BI), 335 polled by default. Binary inputs carry the UPS status and alarm flags (on battery, bypass, low battery, load not powered, warning and critical alarm, module failures, parallel faults); analog inputs give runtime, input/bypass/output voltages and frequencies, % load per phase and installation load.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Schneider_APC_Symmetra_PX_250_500_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the Symmetra PX Modbus register map (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/APC_RegMap.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 335 of the 621 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.
Some names appear more than once in the profile as published (ECT board has an error; Breaker Q1 open; Breaker Q2 open...); they are kept as printed and told apart by instance.

integration.summary: Read on battery, bypass, load not powered and the warning/critical alarm flags, plus runtime and total % load.

minimum_points.name: Load is being powered from battery

setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
